posts.text: The trade war against Canada makes even less sense than the real war against Iran. At least there were actual reasons to fight Iran, they didn't necessarily overcome the reasons not to, but they were real. There's no good reason for a trade war with Canada. It's pure stupid.
posts.summary: Opposes Canada trade war as unjustified and harmful

posts.text: It's interesting that license plate readers are only breaking into mainstream consciousness now. I remember reporting on them like a decade ago. FOIAd my records from my town, and they were tracking where I drove. I guess it wasn't as extensive or coordinated, and in-your-face back then?
